generations.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original high-resolution magazine character key art, portrait 2:3 composition.
Create Billy-Joe, nicknamed BJ, an original plumbing-sector artificial intelligence's proposed physical interface. Memorable, distinctive industrial silhouette, sophisticated photoreal cinematic game marketing rendering with subtle absurd workplace personality.
Design: a compact asymmetrical cream enamel ceramic dispatch-head housing shaped like a broad rounded trapezoidal plumbing junction, perched inside a large weathered brass three-spoke valve-wheel collar. Three UNEQUAL narrow VERTICAL dark glass indicator slots across the front, arranged like an off-center stepped bar graph, glow warm amber at different heights. These are abstract instrument windows, NOT a pair of humanoid eyes and NOT one central camera lens. One small external brass pressure gauge mounted at upper right, its cocky tilted needle suggesting misplaced certainty. A squared copper pipe neck disappears into a solid wall-mounted dark teal utility manifold, with practical numbered hose couplings and heavy bolts. Broad ceramic brow lip lends officious character. Small physical enamel badge reads exactly "BJ", no other text. Designed to be recognizable even as a small icon.
Scene: BJ occupies most of the picture in three-quarter view, facing the viewer from a cramped plumbing distribution control alcove. Out-of-focus copper pipes and warehouse routing cabinets behind him, warm amber practical light, cool teal shadows. Upper three quarters show full unique head/collar silhouette, lower quarter shows sturdy manifold base. Premium tactile materials, condensation, restrained wear, no sludge covering face. Authoritative, helpful, slightly smug bureaucratic character, not an evil robot.
Constraints: entirely original design. No spherical robot, no single glowing central eye, no suspended white robotic shell, no humanoid metal skull, no recognizable existing science-fiction AI design. No corruption, infection, tentacles, villain glow, supernatural imagery, takeover effects or implied origin mechanism. No weapons. No human characters. No logo or title besides small BJ badge. Clean publication-ready composition with safe margins.
